mechanism: Improves NetCreator panel usability: multi-line layer descriptions, enable/disable inputs by layer type, keyboard shortcuts for spin/delete. No market-state sensing algorithm is introduced.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: None traded; tool for model architecture editing
why_new_for_mis: UI/tooling only after full read; no regime, volatility, liquidity, or neural market sensor.
quote: Such a useful toll should also be as user friendly as possible. Thus, in this article, we will try to improve its usability.

idea_name: Deep Q-function as multi-action utility sensor
mechanism: A convolutional+dense net approximates Q(s,a) for Buy/Sell/Flat; each results neuron is expected discounted reward for one action from the current 20-bar×12-feature state (OHLC vs open, tick volume/1000, hour/DoW/month, RSI, CCI, ATR, MACD main/signal). Experience replay samples random historical states; Target Net is a periodically frozen copy used for next-state max Q under Bellman.
data_needed: EURUSD H1 OHLC+tick volume, RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD defaults, HistoryBars from input layer size (20 bars in test), discount γ≈0.9
why_new_for_mis: Frames expected action utility as an explicit neural sensor over multimodal bar+indicator state, with replay and frozen Target Net for stable future-value sensing—usable by MIS as a regime-conditioned edge map across actions.
quote: The neural network is trained to predict the expected value of the action utility Q-function.

idea_name: Unidirectional Bellman targets for trend vs candle noise
mechanism: Instead of Bellman max_a Q(s',a') for every action, update Buy/Sell with same-direction future Q only and use max only for Flat; reward = ±candle body (profitable=+body, flat=−body, losing=−2×body). Intended to reduce noise-chasing every candle and favor holding with trend.
data_needed: Next-bar open/close for reward; Target Net Q vector of size 3
why_new_for_mis: Turns the RL backup rule itself into a trend-regime prior: MIS can adopt direction-aligned value backups as a sensor of whether a state favors continuation vs flip.
quote: To eliminate the influence of the above factor, I decided to divert from the Bellman equation. To update the Q-function model, I will use unidirectional values. The maximum will only be used for the "out of the market" action.

idea_name: ATR and tick-volume in DQN state vector
mechanism: Each bar’s 12-D descriptor includes ATR and tick_volume/1000 alongside RSI/CCI/MACD and OHLC deltas, so the Q-net jointly conditions action utility on realized range and activity.
data_needed: ATR buffer, tick volumes, same HistoryBars window
why_new_for_mis: Bundles volatility (ATR) and activity (tick volume) into the same neural state sensor as price shape—MIS can reuse this multimodal packing for regime/liquidity-aware Q sensing.

idea_name: SoftMax policy probabilities as stochastic action sensor
mechanism: Policy net ends in SoftMax so outputs are a probability simplex over Buy/Sell/Flat; actions are sampled from that distribution (exploration→exploitation as probs concentrate). Train with LogLoss toward one-hot of the taken action, scaled by cumulative discounted session reward (front-loaded: early rewards weighted higher via γ^batch).
data_needed: Session of SesionSize bars; stacks of states/actions/rewards; SoftMax layer; EURUSD H1 multimodal state as in DQN
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; ~2y train; tester OOS; avg hold ~1h40m after penalty retune
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a calibrated stochastic policy sensor (prob mass over actions) rather than a single greedy Q argmax—dispersion of SoftMax can flag ambiguous regimes.
quote: the stochastic policy gradient method. It assumes that our policy function, when assessing the current state of the environment, returns the probability distribution of receiving a positive reward when performing the corresponding action.

mechanism: Critic (pretrained Q-net) supplies V(s)≈max_a Q(s,a); Actor (policy SoftMax) is updated with advantage A=R_cum−V(s) so probability rises only for actions beating the state baseline. Batch sessions of SessionSize; same EURUSD H1 feature stack.
data_needed: Paired Actor+Critic nets; session cumulative discounted rewards; HistoryBars×12 state
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 2y history; OOS tester PF≈2.20, >56% wins
why_new_for_mis: Advantage is an explicit relative-edge sensor: MIS can monitor A(s,a) or Critic V(s) as how much the current bar-state is above/below expected session value.
quote: we replace the constant in the loss function formula above with the state estimate. ... where V(s) is the environment state assessment function.

idea_name: Genetic population optimization of trading nets
mechanism: CNetGenetic runs a population of weight genomes, selects by quantile of cumulative reward, randomly mixes genes with mutation; optimizes same SoftMax policy architecture without gradients. Training method, not a new market sensor.
data_needed: PopulationSize agents, Quantile/Mutation hyperparameters, EURUSD H1 reward sessions
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 2y optimize; leave last month OOS
why_new_for_mis: After full read: evolutionary optimizer for existing policy nets; no new regime/vol/liquidity/sequence sensing construct beyond prior RL state features.
quote: Evolutionary optimization methods are referred to as gradientless methods. They allow the optimizing of models that cannot be optimized by previously considered methods.

mechanism: CNetEvolution adds isotropic noise to weights, scores population by total reward, updates mean weights by reward-centered weighted average of noise (OpenAI ES-style) plus optional mutation. Optimizer, not a market sensor.
data_needed: Population around one model; reward vector; learning rate lr
why_new_for_mis: Full read shows scalable RL alternative optimizer; sensing surface remains the same SoftMax policy over bar+indicator state.
quote: we will add to the parameters of the original model the weighted average of the corresponding parameter noise from all models of the population. The noise will be weighted by the total reward.

mechanism: Instead of scalar Q, output N quantiles per action (e.g. 15×3=45) spanning reward range via Step around a zero-centered median; SoftMax normalizes within each action; targets are one-hot of the quantile bin hit by environment reward + discounted TargetNet quantile. Enables risk reading of P(gain) vs P(loss) for same action.
data_needed: Actions=3, Step (e.g. 5e-4), action_dist from output/Actions, EURUSD H1 state as before
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 2y train; 2-week OOS tester ~56% wins
why_new_for_mis: Upgrades action-value sensing from a mean to a full reward distribution—MIS can sense fat-tail / bipolar reward risk in a state that mean-Q would collapse to ~0.
quote: we will not approximating a single reward value for the completed action in a particular state, but the whole probability distribution of the expected reward.

idea_name: Discount factor as foresight-horizon strategy sensor
mechanism: γ near 1 trains long-horizon investment-like Q strategies; γ near 0 forces short-horizon/scalping attention; TF used further scales holding. Hyperparameter becomes a dial on which temporal regime the utility sensor locks onto.
data_needed: DiscountFactor hyperparameter; same DistQ training loop
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 (holding time coupled to TF)
why_new_for_mis: Makes temporal regime (scalp vs swing) an explicit sensing hyperparameter of the Q distribution model for MIS to sweep or ensemble.
quote: The use of a coefficient close to 1 instructs the model to build long strategies. ... values closer to 0 forces the model to forget about future rewards and to pay more attention to making a profit in the short term. So, the model will build a scalping strategy.

mechanism: QR-DQN predicts median levels of N equiprobable reward quantiles (not fixed-width bins); τ-asymmetric Bellman residual (τ−1)_+ / τ_− weights pull each quantile to the correct mass point. CQRDQN wraps Target Net and maps discrete env rewards into quantile targets; getResults averages quantile means per action.
data_needed: iNumbers quantiles per action (e.g. 31 default), τ midpoints CumSum(1/N), EURUSD H1 multimodal state
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 2y train; 2-week tester; avg win≈2× avg loss
why_new_for_mis: Allocates sensing resolution where reward mass concentrates and sparsifies empty ranges—better MIS risk/quantile sensor under non-stationary reward density than fixed bins.
quote: we divide the set of rewards received into several equally probable quantiles. ... in the area of sparse reward values, we will get larger quantiles. In areas where there will be lots of rewards, quantiles will be broken down into smaller parts.

idea_name: Intrinsic curiosity as forward-embedding prediction error
mechanism: ICM: shared DQN encoder embedding → Forward Model predicts next embedding from (embed, one-hot action); Inverse Model predicts action from (embed_t, embed_t+1). Intrinsic reward ri = MSE(pred, next_embed) added to sparse extrinsic balance Δ; agent is rewarded for visiting poorly predicted transitions. Experience replay buffer stores (state, action, reward).
data_needed: Market OHLC+indicators plus account features (balance/positions); Forward/Inverse nets; embedding layer index; Batch min buffer
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; ~10 months tester training; 4 actions Buy/Sell/CloseAll/Wait
why_new_for_mis: Prediction-error curiosity is a concrete novelty/regime-change sensor when extrinsic PnL is sparse—MIS can track forward-model residual as exploration pressure or unseen-state alarm.
quote: The measure of curiosity is the quality of the prediction. The prediction error computed by MSE is an intrinsic reward.

mechanism: Extrinsic reward is account balance change only (not equity/candle body), so rewards arrive rarely at position close; ICM curiosity fills the gaps. Forces sensing of true locked PnL rather than mark-to-market noise.
data_needed: ACCOUNT_BALANCE deltas between bars; open-position tracking via tester
why_new_for_mis: Defines a sparse cash-settlement reward sensor distinct from bar-body proxies—useful for MIS when aligning RL labels with realized balance events.
quote: The extrinsic reward will be a change in the account balance. Please note it is the balance, not the equity change.

idea_name: Self-Attention relational graph over candle objects
mechanism: After Conv+LSTM preprocessing, a 4-layer multi-head Self-Attention (20 units × 5 feats, 64 heads, key dim 16) builds SoftMax dependency matrices between sequence elements—tabular graph of weighted links among bar/event embeddings—then FQF decision head. Intended to capture relative structure (e.g. channel form→break→retest) that plain convs miss under stretch/distort.
data_needed: HistoryBars multimodal features + 9 account fields; ICM Forward/Inverse; attention stack
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; tester train; PF≈1.31, RF≈2.85, 53.7% wins
why_new_for_mis: Treats attention scores as an explicit relational structure sensor among bars—MIS can read graph connectivity/attention entropy as pattern-regime geometry, not just embeddings.
quote: The resulting matrix of dependence coefficients is a tabular representation of the desired graph. In this matrix, the zero values of the coefficients indicate the absence of links between the corresponding nodes of the source data.

mechanism: When hierarchical RL stopped trading, debug compared prev vs current layer outputs (L1 delta of vectors) per bar; found second conv block (and scheduler) produced nearly identical distributions for all environment states—sensor collapsed. Fix: simplify preprocess (drop FC after conv), split market analysis (agents) from account/risk scheduling, diversify positive-example collection.
data_needed: Per-layer Output buffers; prev_output vectors; ModelsCount of scheduler picks
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD (hierarchical SAC-style stack from prior parts); train early 2023; OOS next 2 weeks
why_new_for_mis: Operational MIS health check: zero bar-to-bar output delta is a regime-blind / stuck-sensor alarm before trusting neural signals.
quote: we found that after the second convolutional layer, the model does not respond to changes in the state of the analyzed system. ... the probability distribution of the model output remains almost the same in all environmental states.

mechanism: Skill-conditioned Actor gets (market+relative account+one-hot skill); Discriminator maps next state→skill SoftMax; Actor reward = CCE(discriminator, skill one-hot) so skills that produce distinguishable next states are reinforced. Scheduler separately maps state→skill probs; later supervised RL maximizes balance. Relative account features: Δbalance/balance, equity/balance, etc.
data_needed: NSkills, NActions, HistoryBars×BarDescr + AccountDescr, trajectory DB; Actor/Scheduler/Discriminator nets
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train Jan–Apr 2023; test first 2 weeks May 2023; PF≈1.61, RF≈3.21
why_new_for_mis: Learns a repertoire of distinct state-conditioned skills without task reward—MIS can treat skill ID / discriminator confusion as a behavioral-regime partition of the market.
quote: the cross-entropy between the discriminator results and the one-hot vector corresponding to the applied skill serves as the reward for our skill model.
